default.title: Default agent
default.description: Preselected for future task sessions. Creating a task does not start an agent.
default.unavailable: The default agent is disabled or unavailable. Select another agent.

operation.title: CLI operation
operation.description: Review the commands before running them. Installs and updates may download software; sign-in and sign-out affect the CLI's default account, including use outside Navo. Output is not saved to diagnostic logs.
operation.manageHint: This CLI does not provide a verified sign-in status command. Manage authentication in its own terminal interface, then stop and re-scan; Navo will not guess the result.

errors.restartRequired: The app is still using an older agent interface. Fully restart Navo; reloading the window is not enough.
errors.capabilities: Model options are temporarily unavailable. Background refresh will retry, or rescan in Agents settings.
errors.capabilitiesPending: Waiting for model options to update in the background.
errors.invalid: Check the agent configuration and executable path.
errors.path: Select an absolute path to an executable file.
errors.unavailable: This agent or operation is unavailable. Re-scan and try again.
errors.busy: Another CLI operation is running. Finish or stop it first.
errors.expired: The command plan has expired or changed. Open it again.
errors.start: Unable to start the CLI operation.
errors.secureStorage: Secure system storage is unavailable. New environment values cannot be saved.
errors.storage: Agent settings could not be read. Existing data has been preserved.
